topic_title: Traffic Flow Management — Control Devices & Law
prompt: What does a steady red 'X' displayed over a highway travel lane indicate to approaching motorists?

options.text: Lane is reserved exclusively for high-occupancy transit vehicles carrying four people
Lane is designated for commercial freight trucks traveling above sixty miles per hour
Lane may be entered temporarily for rapid overtaking maneuvers during peak rush hour
Lane is closed to travel; motorists must merge into an open lane with a green arrow
